reviews.title: Beautiful small form factor case!
reviews.comment: Such a good looking case but if you have a beefy build the heat will not be nice to your pc components. I ran a 4090 with a Asus Ryujin 3 240mm and the heat was too much for the case to exhaust. If your build is less beefy then I'd definitely recommend this case.
